privacy_intro: Been is a hobby project of mine, and I’m the one responsible for it. There are no accounts, no ads, and no server of its own: your map stays on your device. Here’s everything the site collects about you, and what happens to it.
privacy_visits_body: Cloudflare hosts the site, so every request goes through it. Like any web host, it sees your IP address, your browser, and the page you asked for, so it can send you the page and keep the site safe from attacks. I don’t keep any of that myself.
privacy_analytics_body: I count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics. It tells me how many people visited and which pages they looked at, but not who they were.
privacy_map_body: The countries you tick, and the day you ticked each, stay in your browser. They’re never sent to me or to anyone else, and I have no copy of them. Recommendations, visas and stamps are all worked out on your device.
privacy_share_body: A share link carries your map in the part of the address after the #, which browsers don’t send to any server. It only goes where you send it, and anyone you send it to can see the countries on it. Its QR code is made on your device too.
privacy_globe_body: The map under the globe, its coastlines and place names, comes from CARTO. Your browser fetches it from CARTO’s servers as you look around, so CARTO sees your IP address, your browser, and which parts of the world you’re looking at. It doesn’t learn which countries you’ve ticked: the country shapes come from this site.
privacy_others_body: Cloudflare, which runs the hosting, the analytics and the security checks, and CARTO, for the map under the globe. Their networks span the world, so your data may be handled outside the country you’re in. The site uses your device’s own fonts, so your browser doesn’t ask Google for any.
privacy_use_body: Running the site, keeping it secure, drawing the globe, and seeing roughly how many people visit. That’s all: none of it is sold, shared for advertising, or used to build a profile of you.
privacy_signals_body: There’s no tracking to opt out of, so the site treats every visit the same, whether or not your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control.
privacy_rights_body: Your map is yours to clear whenever you like, from the cookies page. Wherever you live, you can also ask me what I hold about you, and ask me to correct or delete it. Depending on where you live, you may also be able to complain to a privacy regulator.
privacy_children_body: Anyone can use Been. It doesn’t ask for anyone’s name, age, email, or location, so it collects no more from children than from anyone else.
privacy_changes_body: If the site starts collecting anything new, I’ll update this page first.
cookies_intro: Here’s everything this site may keep on your device, and how to clear it. It doesn’t set any cookies of its own. The only one you might get is Cloudflare’s, which hosts the site, and only to keep it secure.
cookies_privacy_link: What the site collects about you
cookies_cloudflare_body: When Cloudflare’s bot protection can’t tell whether a visit comes from a person, it asks your browser to pass a quick check. This cookie remembers that you passed, so you aren’t checked again on every page.
cookies_set_by_value: Cloudflare, only if you’re asked to pass a check
cookies_purpose_value: Security: telling people from bots. It isn’t used to identify or follow you.
cookies_kept_for_value: As long as the check lasts, 30 minutes by default
cookies_cloudflare_more: Read more in Cloudflare’s own list of its cookies
cookies_storage_body: Been keeps these in your browser’s local storage, so they’re still there next time. They stay until you clear them, and they’re never sent anywhere. Once you’ve ticked a country, Been also asks your browser to keep them even when it’s short of space, so your map isn’t cleared without you.
cookies_storage_countries: The countries you’ve ticked, and the day you ticked each: your map
cookies_storage_expanded_regions: Which continents you’ve opened in the list
cookies_storage_menu_size: How big you’ve made the list
cookies_storage_warning: Clearing it deletes your map for good. To keep a copy, share a link to it first.
cookies_storage_confirm: Tap again to delete your map
cookies_nothing_else_body: The analytics I use set no cookies and keep nothing on your device, so there’s no banner to click through.
